% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpGameLife[preset=glider,label=Glider,cell-size=14]{}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/game-life/game-life.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-game-life");
element1.setAttribute("preset", "glider");
element1.setAttribute("label", "Glider");
element1.setAttribute("cell-size", "14");
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}
